projects.title: Traco: Java Ray Tracing Engine
projects.description: A photorealistic rendering engine built from scratch in pure Java. It uses a recursive ray tracing algorithm to simulate complex light transport, producing high-fidelity images with realistic shadows, multi-bounce reflections, and supersampling anti-aliasing.

projects.title: Line Follower Robot
projects.description: Engineered a Line Follower bot utilizing Arduino Nano, an 8-IR sensor array and L298N motor driver for precise path detection. Implemented PID control algorithms for stable navigation and optimized performance under diverse operating conditions.

projects.title: Forge_CLI
projects.description: A powerful command-line interface designed to convert KiCad PCB files into high-quality, stylized SVG images. Offers extensive customization, including theme control, layer visibility, and various rendering modes for documentation.

projects.title: Dobosaurus Game
projects.description: Developed a Chrome Dino game clone with smooth gameplay, responsive controls, and engaging UI elements. Features dynamic background, varying obstacle sizes for visual depth, and high-score tracking system.
